name: Skill Search
description: Per-turn skill retrieval: local directory, remote catalog, model-gated selection.

hubEndpoint.description: Remote catalog base URL; empty disables the remote source

hubApiKey.description: Bearer token for the remote catalog

clawhubEndpoint.description: ClawHub API base URL; empty disables this source

skillhubCnEndpoint.description: skillhub.cn API base URL; empty disables this source

model.description: Model for the rewriter and the gate; empty runs retrieval unfiltered

topK.description: Upper bound on skills injected per turn

maxSelect.description: Upper bound on what the gate keeps

availableTools.description: Tool names this agent can call; the host does not report them to a hook, so stating them here restores the gate's environment check

indexBody.description: Index skill bodies alongside name and description. Off by default: the description is the retrieval contract of the SKILL.md format, and is also what the gate reads.

rewrite.description: Clean the query with the model before searching. Needs a model.

gate.description: Let the model drop candidates before they reach the prompt. Unset means on when a catalog is configured. Needs a model.
